translations.lab.title: Design Lab
translations.lab.intro.components: "Calm Glass": the tokens and every component screens are built from, on one page. Development builds only. Every name, number and message here is sample content, written for this page.
translations.lab.colour.note.calmGlass: Values are read live from the page, so they are the ones this theme actually resolved. Emerald is the AI, gold is the team and cream is the customer; a voice is never decoration.
translations.lab.type.note.calmGlass: Geist and IBM Plex Sans Arabic for the interface, Instrument Serif for the display line, all self-hosted. Figures are tabular and stay Western in both languages.
translations.lab.shape.panel: A panel: solid, a 1px line, no shadow.
translations.lab.shape.tile: A tile inside it: the soft fill.
translations.lab.glass.note: Glass only where things float: menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs, toasts and, from the next step, the side bar. At most three blurred layers on screen, and never on a list that scrolls. With "Reduce transparency" each one becomes its solid twin.
translations.lab.shape.glassSample: Glass: only where things float, and the only surface that casts a shadow. With "Reduce transparency" it becomes its solid twin.
translations.lab.glass.result: Blurred layers on screen now: {$INTERPOLATION} (the budget is 3).
translations.lab.mark.note.circles: Two circles, the AI and the team, and the one tone where they meet. Never mirrored, rotated or given a gradient. One colour: the outlines and the filled overlap.
translations.lab.buttons.note.calmGlass: Pills, 44px tall (40px in dense headers), weight 600. One primary per area. Hover, press and focus are live: point at them, or press Tab.
translations.lab.choices.note: One family: a visible 20px box or a 40×24 track inside a 44px target, and the label is part of the target. Each wraps the native control, so keyboard and screen readers behave as they always do.
translations.lab.choices.longHint: Open the inbox and read every message, without replying.
translations.lab.choices.segmented.note: Radios for a choice in a form, links when the choice is an address (never tabs for an address), buttons for a choice that acts at once.

translations.lab.forms.address.error: Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.
translations.lab.colour.sideBySide.note.calmGlass: Status words reuse the three hues, each with its own glyph and word, so none depends on its hue. In the inbox and the transcript only the voice chips appear.
translations.lab.rows.note: Radius 16, a 40px avatar with its channel's badge and glyph, the name and the time, one line of preview, then chips. Selected is a faint emerald tint; unread is a dot, a heavier name and the word "Unread" for screen readers.

translations.permission.knowledge.view.description: Read the workspace's knowledge documents, see whether each one is indexed, and test what an agent would retrieve for a question.

translations.permission.reports.schedule.description: Create weekly and monthly reports that are generated automatically under your own permissions.
